general.title: General
general.description: How the app speaks to you, and what the top bar shows.
general.language.title: Language
general.language.description: The language of menus, buttons and messages. What you write stays as you wrote it. Some screens are still being translated.
general.topBar.title: Top bar
general.topBar.description: The bar at the top of every page.
general.worldDate.label: In-world date
general.worldDate.description: Shows the current date of your world, read in the default calendar, in the middle of the bar. Click it to open Calendars.
formats.title: Units & formats
formats.description: How measurements and dates are shown. Stored values never change, only how they read.
formats.units.title: Units
formats.units.description: Used by travel times and supplies, new maps' scale bars, and the examples in measurement fields. What you type in an article stays as written.
formats.length.label: Length and distance
formats.numbers.title: Numbers
formats.numbers.description: How the numbers the app writes are grouped: areas, distances, totals, XP and coins. Numbers you type in your text stay as written.
formats.numbers.label: Number format
formats.dates.title: Dates
formats.dates.description: Real-world dates (sessions played, revisions, trash) and in-world dates from your calendars each have their own format.
formats.dates.worldExample: Example: {date}. Numbers count months in calendar order.
data.title: Data
data.description: Move your maps between installations, or keep a copy.
data.maps.title: Maps data
data.maps.description: Covers maps, their images, markers, categories and descriptions.
data.export.description: Downloads everything as one .json file, images included.
data.import.description: Adds the file's maps, markers and descriptions as new items. Images are re-tiled in the background.
data.import.summary: Imported {maps} map(s), {markers} marker(s) and {documents} description(s). {assets} image(s) queued for tiling.
